card.name: Last letter of medical acronyms
card.fires_on: The final letter of a spelled-out acronym in parentheses, mainly the I in TRALI and the P in PEP. It also fires weakly on small words like "of" or "%" after a patient count or percentage.

modes.label: Acronym end letter
modes.description: Last letter of a bracketed abbreviation right after its full name, closing the acronym.
modes.example: Transfusion-Related Acute Lung Injury (TRAL<<I>>) Non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema

modes.label: After a rate or count
modes.description: A small word or symbol following an incidence figure, just before "patients".
modes.example: occurred in 0.4% (1/223, Grade 1)<< of>> patients receiving UNLOXCYT.
